thesis: GLP-1 incumbent ceding US obesity share to Lilly tirzepatide; investment case re-underwritten as a share-defender + pipeline option. Defense levers: Wegovy pill (oral sema, US approved Jan 2026), self-pay channel + price ($349 from Nov'25), IO Obesity expansion (45+ countries). Optionality: CagriSema (REIMAGINE 2/3 hit primary endpoints; REDEFINE-1 readout pending), amycretin (next-gen GLP-1+amylin), MASH (Akero acquisition), Decenimig (Mim8 hemophilia A). Binary 2026 catalyst: CMS Medicare Part D obesity coverage decision (CMMI pilot, mid-year).
thesis_status_note: Original 'durable 20%+ supply-constrained-growth' thesis is broken (FY25 +10% CER vs 16-24% initial guide; FY26 guide -5% to -13% adj CER). Schema rewritten 2026-05-04 to monitor share-defense execution + pipeline delivery rather than top-line growth.

Obesity care CER growth <0% YoY (would signal franchise repricing rather than slowdown)

CagriSema REDEFINE-1 readout misses primary endpoint OR amycretin discontinued for safety/efficacy
CMS Medicare Part D obesity coverage decision negative or delayed beyond 2026 (binary catalyst miss)

schema_revision_notes: 2026-05-04: FULL THESIS REWRITE. Original supply-constrained-growth thesis is structurally broken (FY25 +10% CER vs initial 16-24% guide; FY26 guide -5% to -13% adj). Pivoted KPI set from growth metrics to share-defense + pipeline-execution metrics. New T1 KPIs reflect what management can actually be measured against in the new regime: US TRx share vs tirzepatide, Obesity care CER (the franchise still growing), Wegovy self-pay economics (the active defense lever), Operating Margin (deleverage check), and pipeline milestone delivery (the optionality value). New break conditions are name-specific (Wegovy pill ramp, CagriSema readout, CMS decision) rather than generic growth thresholds. Previous schema's 4 of 5 break conditions had already triggered on the new regime.
